summary: Full backend + frontend review for CAOS Care MVP. Found and fixed a critical blocker: every POST endpoint that inserted docs into MongoDB returned 500 because motor's insert_one mutates the dict with an ObjectId '_id' which FastAPI then cannot serialize. After the fix, 32/32 backend pytest tests pass (health, auth, residents CRUD, kiosks/zones CRUD, staff admin-only, alerts full lifecycle, locations ingest + mock + latest, AI chat via Claude Sonnet 4.5, OpenAI TTS, STT endpoint presence). Frontend flows verified via Playwright: landing, kiosk/demo emergency-button flow (alert created, AI greeting rendered, TTS spoken), staff dashboard live alerts + locations, admin 4-tab community panel.

minor.issue: Deleting a resident leaves orphaned documents in `locations` collection (TEST Jane Doe still visible in /locations/latest via resident join until list is filtered). Consider cascade delete or filtering latest by existing residents only.
Public endpoint has no rate-limit / abuse protection; any client can spam alerts.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid="add-zone-btn" not found by selector during automation (other add-*-btn testids work). Please verify the attribute is attached to the Add Zone button.

issues: Console shows two 401s for an authenticated call (likely /auth/me probe without token). Harmless but noisy; guard the call when on the public kiosk route.

action_items: (Already fixed by testing agent) pop '_id' after insert_one on residents/kiosks/zones/alerts/locations + mock/generate so responses serialize cleanly.
Add data-testid="add-zone-btn" to the Zones-tab add button in Admin.jsx if missing.
Suppress /auth/me probe on public /kiosk/* routes (kills 401 console noise).
Consider cascading delete of locations + chat_messages when a resident is removed.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/*.py: consistent MongoDB anti-pattern was returning the same dict passed to insert_one (which motor mutates with ObjectId). Fixed, but recommend centralising a helper like `await insert_and_return(db.coll, doc)` that always pops '_id'.

auth.py: password_hash column excluded via find_one projections in deps.get_current_user but login handler pulls full doc (fine, but ensure UserPublic strips password_hash explicitly — currently relies on model excluding it).
location.py /locations (public ingest): no auth + no signed-sensor check; in production this should require an HMAC or device token.
ai.py /ai/stt: uses tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile with delete=False and a best-effort unlink in finally; ensure the file is removed on exception too (wrap with try/finally).
Seed runs inside FastAPI lifespan with a broad try/except that only logs a warning — seed failures go unnoticed in production logs.

seed_data_creation: Seed auto-populates on backend startup: 7 residents (6 seeded + 1 TEST leftover-safe), 2 users, 8 kiosks, 5 zones. Tests create TEST_-prefixed users/residents and clean them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend ObjectId/_id bug is fixed in 5 routes. If any new POST endpoint is added, ensure it pops '_id' before returning the inserted doc or returns a fresh model_dump(). Pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py runs in ~9s end-to-end and exercises all critical paths including Claude chat + OpenAI TTS (requires EMERGENT_LLM_KEY).
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: FastAPI's jsonable_encoder cannot serialize bson.ObjectId. Motor's AsyncIOMotorCollection.insert_one mutates the passed dict in-place to add `_id: ObjectId(...)`. Routes returned the same dict, so FastAPI tried to serialize ObjectId → ValueError('vars() argument must have __dict__ attribute') → HTTP 500. Reproduction: POST /api/residents with valid body and admin Bearer → 500. Fix applied: `doc.pop('_id', None)` after every insert_one in residents.py, kiosks.py, alerts.py, location.py (incl. mock/generate). Verified by pytest run: 7 previously-failing endpoints now 200.
